text:
rachel: Proposal: sofa snail races this Friday during lunch. bring a tiny toy snail or nominate a plush. low stakes, high morale. :snail:

omar: love this. we need lanes (taped), a starting horn (mee-oo?), and a tiny finish line. prize: golden remote?

tia: i'm on tape duty. also can we have a mascot named Sir Slowsalot? mandatory top hat.

noah: rule suggestions: 1) only wind-up snails or plush allowed, 2) no human pushing, 3) best slow-win gets crown of couch crumbs.

ops-bot: Poll created: "Which snail should represent Team Left Cushion?" Options: 'blue wind-up', 'felt snail (tia)', 'fernus the plant (honorary)'.

plant-bot: fernus expresses enthusiastic leaf wiggle and accepts honorary snailing duties if provided a tiny scarf. :seedling:

omar: can we stream to the breakroom TV? dramatic commentary required. i volunteer as announcer: "and they're off... sort of."

rachel: official bracket: Left Cushion vs Right Cushion, Middle Pillow wild-card. best of 3.

tia: also, photo-op for the living wall. permanent plaque: "Sofa Snail Olympics 2026 inaugural champions". i'll hand-letter it.

ops-bot: Poll results: blue wind-up 2, felt snail (tia) 1, fernus 2 1 tie between blue and plant. Suggested tie-breaker: scarf toss at noon.

noah: scarf toss accepted. loser supplies snail-safe snacks (aka lettuce leaves) and writes a haiku about patience.

omar: commentary team will require sound effects and a tiny bell. also, can we have a slow-motion replay? someone bring a phone.

rachel: safety note: no caffeinated encouragement. snails get nervous.

plant-bot: fernus will provide moral support and ambient oxygen. :herb:

tia: i'm designing medals: tiny washers painted gold, with a ribbon. eco-friendly and very chic.

omar: long live Sir Slowsalot. see you at lunch. prepare your snail spouse.
